enrollment.summary: Intune enrollment failures for one user are discriminated by the enrollment restriction blade before any device reset
enrollment.detail: Check Devices > Enrollment > Device platform restriction for the user's group first; a blocked platform explains the failure without touching the device.

compliance.summary: A newly enrolled device reads Not compliant until its first compliance check-in completes inside the grace period
compliance.detail: Wait for the first check-in before acting on a Not compliant state of a device enrolled within the grace period.

vendorClaim.summary: A vendor email claims the hybrid join wait can now be skipped for every new laptop
